definitions.ask: Should the agent propose one live sase-core release cut after the fix lands, instead of awaiting the daily cut?
definitions.why: Matches the approved core_cut=wait precedent on sase-1pi; the daily cut verifies it for free

choices.label: The next scheduled cut proves the fix; no off-schedule release or extra PyPI quota
Agent files a /sase_gate for one live cut; v0.44.0 ships ~1 day sooner for ~75 MB of quota

definitions.ask: Should a heal run still refresh a current release PR once per UTC day so its changelog date tracks the cut day?
definitions.why: The date names the newest change the release holds, and each skipped refresh saves a macOS run

choices.label: Never refresh a current PR; the date marks the last master change; no extra CI runs
First heal run of each UTC day refreshes a current PR (one extra CI run a day); cuts never do
